decisions.old_assertion: HTTP success and the expected identity phrase in Markdown body
decisions.new_assertion: HTTP success AND the complete current English documentation-purpose sentence in Markdown body AND the exact expected identity in canonical metadata.title
decisions.intended_capability: Canonical static-page content plus separate title/metadata (SPEC31.1/AC03); inference about current capability, not evidence of original author intent
decisions.intent_authority: Current canonical capability and observed source; chronological cause and original author intent unknown
decisions.why_not_retrieval_failure: The expected title is returned in metadata and the current visible source purpose text is present in returned Markdown; missing title duplication does not demonstrate lost body content
decisions.why_not_easier: The expected title cannot substitute for Markdown. A source-backed complete body sentence and exact metadata title are both required. Empty body, identity-only Markdown, wrong metadata or absent purpose text fail. The old check demanded text absent from the actual source body, so it measured an unsatisfiable premise rather than correct current retrieval.
decisions.source_change_since_freeze: UNKNOWN; no pre-freeze HTML was retained. Do not label this as a proven later source change.
decisions.language_variant: The independent HTTPS response is English-only (577 bytes), while the historical browser HTML includes translations (2373 bytes). Both place identity in title and contain the same English body-purpose sentence.
decisions.original_author_intent: UNKNOWN: no preserved author statement settles whether identity or literal Markdown location was intended
decisions.classification_limit: INCORRECT_TEST_FORMULATION is the owner-required category for a check that cannot measure correct current-source retrieval. It does not assert original author error or prove that the source changed after freeze; historical source drift is also possible.
decisions.outcome_determinative: Under the observed P01/P02 source and a still-failing P19, the old assertions permit at most17/20, below18required. This correction can be acceptance-determinative. Both preserved P01/P02 documents meet the replacement body/title assertions, but no historical result is rescored; only a fresh complete20-run can establish a new score.
